data.narrative:
Hermeus, a Series C hypersonic propulsion company founded by AJ Piplica, Skyler Shuford, Glenn Case, and Mike Smayda, is valued at $1.0B post-money with $500M raised to date. The Supersonic & Hypersonic sector contains 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 1 private peer (Boom Supersonic), though the narrow peer set limits broad-based valuation triangulation.

Stage-progression analysis, the applicable method given data constraints, applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier from the last post-money valuation of $1.0B to estimate Series C advancement to next-stage funding, yielding $1.7B. This multiplier reflects typical market step-ups between Series C and later institutional rounds. Peer-median analysis is not applied because the Supersonic & Hypersonic sector lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables (fewer than 3 datapoints) meeting narrow filtration criteria; reliance on broader sector medians would introduce undue noise given the specialized nature of this technology.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B to $2.0B, with a median estimate of $1.7B. Key uncertainties include regulatory pathway timing for supersonic/hypersonic flight, competitive intensity as adjacent aerospace firms enter the space, and the sparse public market comparables for validation. The stage-progression method, while internally consistent, rests on limited peer support and should be stress-tested against market conditions and milestone achievement before institutional deployment.
